title: Derived Invariants from Gentle Quivers with Relations
statement: Given only the quiver with relations $(Q(\Delta),I(\Delta))$ defining a gentle algebra $A(\Delta)$, find an algorithm that computes its full derived-equivalence invariant, including the genus, puncture and boundary data, winding-number invariants, and the remaining parity or greatest-common-divisor invariants.

**Source report:** [Representation Theory of Quivers and Finite Dimensional Algebras (2021), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2020/3, pp. 143--230](https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2020/3)

## Literature review (checked 2026-08-22)

**Status:** open

**Assessment.** The complete derived invariant is known abstractly for gentle algebras, but a general effective algorithm extracting every invariant from the quiver with relations is still not supplied.
